audit_status.source_base: Hebrew Leviticus / Vayiqra clean-unclean animal text tradition, draft aligned later
audit_status.review_note: First-pass draft reviewed for land animals, water creatures, birds, swarming things, carcass impurity, vessels, and holiness refrain. Strong anti-disgust/body-shame safeguards required.

verses.restored: YHWH spoke to Moses and to Aaron, saying to them,

familiar.text: And the LORD spake unto Moses and to Aaron, saying unto them,

modern.text: The LORD spoke again to Moses and Aaron, telling them,

original.text: וַיְדַבֵּ֧ר יְהוָ֛ה אֶל מֹשֶׁ֥ה וְאֶֽל אַהֲרֹ֖ן לֵאמֹ֥ר אֲלֵהֶֽם

verses.restored: Speak to children of Israel, saying: These are the living creatures that you may eat from all beasts that are upon earth.

familiar.text: Speak unto the children of Israel, saying, These are the beasts which ye shall eat among all the beasts that are on the earth.

modern.text: “Say to the Israelites, ‘Of all the beasts of the earth, these ones you may eat:

original.text: דַּבְּר֛וּ אֶל בְּנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל לֵאמֹ֑ר זֹ֤את הַֽחַיָּה֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר תֹּאכְל֔וּ מִכָּל הַבְּהֵמָ֖ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר עַל הָאָֽרֶץ

verses.restored: Whatever divides hoof, splits cleft in hoof, and brings up cud among beasts, that you may eat.

familiar.text: Whatsoever parteth the hoof, and is clovenfooted, and cheweth the cud, among the beasts, that shall ye eat.

modern.text: You may eat any animal that has a split hoof completely divided and that chews the cud.

original.text: כֹּ֣ל מַפְרֶ֣סֶת פַּרְסָ֗ה וְשֹׁסַ֤עַת שֶׁ֨סַע֙ פְּרָסֹ֔ת מַעֲלַ֥ת גֵּרָ֖ה בַּבְּהֵמָ֑ה אֹתָ֖הּ תֹּאכֵֽלוּ

verses.restored: But these you shall not eat from those bringing up cud or dividing hoof: camel, for it brings up cud but hoof it does not divide; unclean it is to you.

familiar.text: Nevertheless these shall ye not eat of them that chew the cud, or of them that divide the hoof: as the camel, because he cheweth the cud, but divideth not the hoof; he is unclean unto you.

modern.text: But of those that only chew the cud or only have a divided hoof, you are not to eat the following: The camel, though it chews the cud, does not have a divided hoof; it is unclean for you.

original.text: אַ֤ךְ אֶת זֶה֙ לֹ֣א תֹֽאכְל֔וּ מִֽמַּעֲלֵי֙ הַגֵּרָ֔ה וּמִמַּפְרִיסֵ֖י הַפַּרְסָ֑ה אֶֽת הַ֠גָּמָל כִּֽי מַעֲלֵ֨ה גֵרָ֜ה ה֗וּא וּפַרְסָה֙ אֵינֶ֣נּוּ מַפְרִ֔יס טָמֵ֥א ה֖וּא לָכֶֽם

verses.restored: And hyrax, for it brings up cud but hoof it does not divide; unclean it is to you.

familiar.text: And the coney, because he cheweth the cud, but divideth not the hoof; he is unclean unto you.

modern.text: The rock badger, though it chews the cud, does not have a divided hoof; it is unclean for you.

original.text: וְאֶת הַשָּׁפָ֗ן כִּֽי מַעֲלֵ֤ה גֵרָה֙ ה֔וּא וּפַרְסָ֖ה לֹ֣א יַפְרִ֑יס טָמֵ֥א ה֖וּא לָכֶֽם

verses.restored: And hare, for it brings up cud but hoof it does not divide; unclean it is to you.

familiar.text: And the hare, because he cheweth the cud, but divideth not the hoof; he is unclean unto you.

modern.text: The rabbit, though it chews the cud, does not have a divided hoof; it is unclean for you.

original.text: וְאֶת הָאַרְנֶ֗בֶת כִּֽי מַעֲלַ֤ת גֵּרָה֙ הִ֔וא וּפַרְסָ֖ה לֹ֣א הִפְרִ֑יסָה טְמֵאָ֥ה הִ֖וא לָכֶֽם

verses.restored: And pig, for it divides hoof and splits cleft in hoof, but cud it does not chew; unclean it is to you.

familiar.text: And the swine, though he divide the hoof, and be clovenfooted, yet he cheweth not the cud; he is unclean to you.

modern.text: And the pig, though it has a split hoof completely divided, does not chew the cud; it is unclean for you.

original.text: וְאֶת הַ֠חֲזִיר כִּֽי מַפְרִ֨יס פַּרְסָ֜ה ה֗וּא וְשֹׁסַ֥ע שֶׁ֨סַע֙ פַּרְסָ֔ה וְה֖וּא גֵּרָ֣ה לֹֽא יִגָּ֑ר טָמֵ֥א ה֖וּא לָכֶֽם

verses.restored: From their flesh you shall not eat, and their carcass you shall not touch; unclean they are to you.

familiar.text: Of their flesh shall ye not eat, and their carcase shall ye not touch; they are unclean to you.

modern.text: You must not eat their meat or touch their carcasses; they are unclean for you.

original.text: מִבְּשָׂרָם֙ לֹ֣א תֹאכֵ֔לוּ וּבְנִבְלָתָ֖ם לֹ֣א תִגָּ֑עוּ טְמֵאִ֥ים הֵ֖ם לָכֶֽם

verses.restored: These you may eat from all that are in waters: all that has fin and scale in waters, in seas and streams, them you may eat.

familiar.text: These shall ye eat of all that are in the waters: whatsoever hath fins and scales in the waters, in the seas, and in the rivers, them shall ye eat.

modern.text: Of all the creatures that live in the water, whether in the seas or in the streams, you may eat anything with fins and scales.

original.text: אֶת זֶה֙ תֹּֽאכְל֔וּ מִכֹּ֖ל אֲשֶׁ֣ר בַּמָּ֑יִם כֹּ֣ל אֲשֶׁר לוֹ֩ סְנַפִּ֨יר וְקַשְׂקֶ֜שֶׂת בַּמַּ֗יִם בַּיַּמִּ֛ים וּבַנְּחָלִ֖ים אֹתָ֥ם תֹּאכֵֽלוּ

verses.restored: But all that has no fin and scale in seas and streams, from every swarming thing of waters and every living soul/life in waters, detestable/ritually prohibited they are to you.

familiar.text: And all that have not fins and scales in the seas, and in the rivers, of all that move in the waters, and of any living thing which is in the waters, they shall be an abomination unto you:

modern.text: But the following among all the teeming life and creatures in the water are detestable to you: everything in the seas or streams that does not have fins and scales.

original.text: וְכֹל֩ אֲשֶׁ֨ר אֵֽין ל֜וֹ סְנַפִּ֣יר וְקַשְׂקֶ֗שֶׂת בַּיַּמִּים֙ וּבַנְּחָלִ֔ים מִכֹּל֙ שֶׁ֣רֶץ הַמַּ֔יִם וּמִכֹּ֛ל נֶ֥פֶשׁ הַחַיָּ֖ה אֲשֶׁ֣ר בַּמָּ֑יִם שֶׁ֥קֶץ הֵ֖ם לָכֶֽם

verses.restored: They shall be detestable/ritually prohibited to you; from their flesh you shall not eat, and their carcass you shall detest/avoid.

familiar.text: They shall be even an abomination unto you; ye shall not eat of their flesh, but ye shall have their carcases in abomination.

modern.text: They shall be an abomination to you; you must not eat their meat, and you must detest their carcasses.

original.text: וְשֶׁ֖קֶץ יִהְי֣וּ לָכֶ֑ם מִבְּשָׂרָם֙ לֹ֣א תֹאכֵ֔לוּ וְאֶת נִבְלָתָ֖ם תְּשַׁקֵּֽצוּ

verses.restored: All that has no fin and scale in waters, detestable/ritually prohibited it is to you.

familiar.text: Whatsoever hath no fins nor scales in the waters, that shall be an abomination unto you.

modern.text: Everything in the water that does not have fins and scales shall be detestable to you.

original.text: כֹּ֣ל אֲשֶׁ֥ר אֵֽין ל֛וֹ סְנַפִּ֥יר וְקַשְׂקֶ֖שֶׂת בַּמָּ֑יִם שֶׁ֥קֶץ ה֖וּא לָכֶֽם

verses.restored: These you shall detest/avoid from birds; they shall not be eaten, detestable/ritually prohibited they are: eagle, vulture, black vulture,

familiar.text: And these are they which ye shall have in abomination among the fowls; they shall not be eaten, they are an abomination: the eagle, and the ossifrage, and the ospray,

modern.text: Additionally, you are to detest the following birds, and they must not be eaten because they are detestable: the eagle, the bearded vulture, the black vulture,

original.text: וְאֶת אֵ֨לֶּה֙ תְּשַׁקְּצ֣וּ מִן הָע֔וֹף לֹ֥א יֵאָכְל֖וּ שֶׁ֣קֶץ הֵ֑ם אֶת הַנֶּ֨שֶׁר֙ וְאֶת הַפֶּ֔רֶס וְאֵ֖ת הָעָזְנִיָּֽה

verses.restored: kite and falcon according to its kind,

familiar.text: And the vulture, and the kite after his kind;

modern.text: the kite, any kind of falcon,

original.text: וְאֶת הַ֨דָּאָ֔ה וְאֶת הָאַיָּ֖ה לְמִינָֽהּ

verses.restored: every raven according to its kind,

familiar.text: Every raven after his kind;

modern.text: any kind of raven,

original.text: אֵ֥ת כָּל עֹרֵ֖ב לְמִינֽוֹ

verses.restored: ostrich, nighthawk, gull, hawk according to its kind,

familiar.text: And the owl, and the night hawk, and the cuckow, and the hawk after his kind,

modern.text: the ostrich, the screech owl, the gull, any kind of hawk,

original.text: וְאֵת֙ בַּ֣ת הַֽיַּעֲנָ֔ה וְאֶת הַתַּחְמָ֖ס וְאֶת הַשָּׁ֑חַף וְאֶת הַנֵּ֖ץ לְמִינֵֽהוּ

verses.restored: little owl, cormorant, great owl,

familiar.text: And the little owl, and the cormorant, and the great owl,

modern.text: the little owl, the cormorant, the great owl,

original.text: וְאֶת הַכּ֥וֹס וְאֶת הַשָּׁלָ֖ךְ וְאֶת הַיַּנְשֽׁוּף

verses.restored: white owl, pelican, carrion vulture,

familiar.text: And the swan, and the pelican, and the gier eagle,

modern.text: the white owl, the desert owl, the osprey,

original.text: וְאֶת הַתִּנְשֶׁ֥מֶת וְאֶת הַקָּאָ֖ת וְאֶת הָרָחָֽם

verses.restored: stork, heron according to its kind, hoopoe, and bat.

familiar.text: And the stork, the heron after her kind, and the lapwing, and the bat.

modern.text: the stork, any kind of heron, the hoopoe, and the bat.

original.text: וְאֵת֙ הַחֲסִידָ֔ה הָאֲנָפָ֖ה לְמִינָ֑הּ וְאֶת הַדּוּכִיפַ֖ת וְאֶת הָעֲטַלֵּֽף

verses.restored: All winged swarming things walking on four, detestable/ritually prohibited they are to you.

familiar.text: All fowls that creep, going upon all four, shall be an abomination unto you.

modern.text: All flying insects that walk on all fours are detestable to you.

original.text: כֹּ֚ל שֶׁ֣רֶץ הָע֔וֹף הַהֹלֵ֖ךְ עַל אַרְבַּ֑ע שֶׁ֥קֶץ ה֖וּא לָכֶֽם

verses.restored: Yet these you may eat from all winged swarming things walking on four: those that have jointed legs above their feet, to leap with them upon earth.

familiar.text: Yet these may ye eat of every flying creeping thing that goeth upon all four, which have legs above their feet, to leap withal upon the earth;

modern.text: However, you may eat the following kinds of flying insects that walk on all fours: those having jointed legs above their feet for hopping on the ground.

original.text: אַ֤ךְ אֶת זֶה֙ תֹּֽאכְל֔וּ מִכֹּל֙ שֶׁ֣רֶץ הָע֔וֹף הַהֹלֵ֖ךְ עַל אַרְבַּ֑ע אֲשֶׁר לא כְרָעַ֨יִם֙ מִמַּ֣עַל לְרַגְלָ֔יו לְנַתֵּ֥ר בָּהֵ֖ן עַל הָאָֽרֶץ

verses.restored: These from them you may eat: locust according to its kind, bald locust according to its kind, cricket according to its kind, and grasshopper according to its kind.

familiar.text: Even these of them ye may eat; the locust after his kind, and the bald locust after his kind, and the beetle after his kind, and the grasshopper after his kind.

modern.text: Of these you may eat any kind of locust, katydid, cricket, or grasshopper.

original.text: אֶת אֵ֤לֶּה מֵהֶם֙ תֹּאכֵ֔לוּ אֶת הָֽאַרְבֶּ֣ה לְמִינ֔וֹ וְאֶת הַסָּלְעָ֖ם לְמִינֵ֑הוּ וְאֶת הַחַרְגֹּ֣ל לְמִינֵ֔הוּ וְאֶת הֶחָגָ֖ב לְמִינֵֽהוּ

verses.restored: All other winged swarming things that have four feet, detestable/ritually prohibited they are to you.

familiar.text: But all other flying creeping things, which have four feet, shall be an abomination unto you.

modern.text: All other flying insects that have four legs are detestable to you.

original.text: וְכֹל֙ שֶׁ֣רֶץ הָע֔וֹף אֲשֶׁר ל֖וֹ אַרְבַּ֣ע רַגְלָ֑יִם שֶׁ֥קֶץ ה֖וּא לָכֶֽם

verses.restored: By these you shall become unclean; everyone touching their carcass shall be unclean until evening.

familiar.text: And for these ye shall be unclean: whosoever toucheth the carcase of them shall be unclean until the even.

modern.text: These creatures will make you unclean. Whoever touches their carcasses will be unclean until evening,

original.text: וּלְאֵ֖לֶּה תִּטַּמָּ֑אוּ כָּל הַנֹּגֵ֥עַ בְּנִבְלָתָ֖ם יִטְמָ֥א עַד הָעָֽרֶב

verses.restored: Everyone carrying from their carcass shall wash garments and be unclean until evening.

familiar.text: And whosoever beareth ought of the carcase of them shall wash his clothes, and be unclean until the even.

modern.text: and whoever picks up one of their carcasses must wash his clothes, and he will be unclean until evening.

original.text: וְכָל הַנֹּשֵׂ֖א מִנִּבְלָתָ֑ם יְכַבֵּ֥ס בְּגָדָ֖יו וְטָמֵ֥א עַד הָעָֽרֶב

verses.restored: Every beast that divides hoof but does not split cleft or does not bring up cud is unclean to you; everyone touching them shall be unclean.

familiar.text: The carcases of every beast which divideth the hoof, and is not clovenfooted, nor cheweth the cud, are unclean unto you: every one that toucheth them shall be unclean.

modern.text: Every animal with hooves not completely divided or that does not chew the cud is unclean for you. Whoever touches any of them will be unclean.

original.text: לְֽכָל הַבְּהֵמָ֡ה אֲשֶׁ֣ר הִוא֩ מַפְרֶ֨סֶת פַּרְסָ֜ה וְשֶׁ֣סַע אֵינֶ֣נָּה שֹׁסַ֗עַת וְגֵרָה֙ אֵינֶ֣נָּה מַעֲלָ֔ה טְמֵאִ֥ים הֵ֖ם לָכֶ֑ם כָּל הַנֹּגֵ֥עַ בָּהֶ֖ם יִטְמָֽא

verses.restored: All that walks on paws among all living creatures walking on four are unclean to you; everyone touching their carcass shall be unclean until evening.

familiar.text: And whatsoever goeth upon his paws, among all manner of beasts that go on all four, those are unclean unto you: whoso toucheth their carcase shall be unclean until the even.

modern.text: All the four-footed animals that walk on their paws are unclean for you; whoever touches their carcasses will be unclean until evening,

original.text: וְכֹ֣ל הוֹלֵ֣ךְ עַל כַּפָּ֗יו בְּכָל הַֽחַיָּה֙ הַהֹלֶ֣כֶת עַל אַרְבַּ֔ע טְמֵאִ֥ים הֵ֖ם לָכֶ֑ם כָּל הַנֹּגֵ֥עַ בְּנִבְלָתָ֖ם יִטְמָ֥א עַד הָעָֽרֶב

verses.restored: The one carrying their carcass shall wash garments and be unclean until evening; unclean they are to you.

familiar.text: And he that beareth the carcase of them shall wash his clothes, and be unclean until the even: they are unclean unto you.

modern.text: and anyone who picks up a carcass must wash his clothes, and he will be unclean until evening. They are unclean for you.

original.text: וְהַנֹּשֵׂא֙ אֶת נִבְלָתָ֔ם יְכַבֵּ֥ס בְּגָדָ֖יו וְטָמֵ֣א עַד הָעָ֑רֶב טְמֵאִ֥ים הֵ֖מָּה לָכֶֽם

verses.restored: These are unclean to you among swarming things swarming on earth: mole-rat, mouse, great lizard according to its kind,

familiar.text: These also shall be unclean unto you among the creeping things that creep upon the earth; the weasel, and the mouse, and the tortoise after his kind,

modern.text: The following creatures that move along the ground are unclean for you: the mole, the mouse, any kind of great lizard,

original.text: וְזֶ֤ה לָכֶם֙ הַטָּמֵ֔א בַּשֶּׁ֖רֶץ הַשֹּׁרֵ֣ץ עַל הָאָ֑רֶץ הַחֹ֥לֶד וְהָעַכְבָּ֖ר וְהַצָּ֥ב לְמִינֵֽהוּ

verses.restored: gecko, monitor lizard, lizard, skink, and chameleon.

familiar.text: And the ferret, and the chameleon, and the lizard, and the snail, and the mole.

modern.text: the gecko, the monitor lizard, the common lizard, the skink, and the chameleon.

original.text: וְהָאֲנָקָ֥ה וְהַכֹּ֖חַ וְהַלְּטָאָ֑ה וְהַחֹ֖מֶט וְהַתִּנְשָֽׁמֶת

verses.restored: These are unclean to you among all swarming things; everyone touching them when dead shall be unclean until evening.

familiar.text: These are unclean to you among all that creep: whosoever doth touch them, when they be dead, shall be unclean until the even.

modern.text: These animals are unclean for you among all the crawling creatures. Whoever touches them when they are dead shall be unclean until evening.

original.text: אֵ֛לֶּה הַטְּמֵאִ֥ים לָכֶ֖ם בְּכָל הַשָּׁ֑רֶץ כָּל הַנֹּגֵ֧עַ בָּהֶ֛ם בְּמֹתָ֖ם יִטְמָ֥א עַד הָעָֽרֶב

verses.restored: Anything upon which one of them falls when dead shall be unclean, any vessel of wood, garment, skin, sack, any vessel with which work is done; it shall be put into water and be unclean until evening, then clean.

familiar.text: And upon whatsoever any of them, when they are dead, doth fall, it shall be unclean; whether it be any vessel of wood, or raiment, or skin, or sack, whatsoever vessel it be, wherein any work is done, it must be put into water, and it shall be unclean until the even; so it shall be cleansed.

modern.text: When one of them dies and falls on something, that article becomes unclean; any article of wood, clothing, leather, sackcloth, or any implement used for work must be rinsed with water and will remain unclean until evening; then it will be clean.

original.text: וְכֹ֣ל אֲשֶׁר יִפֹּל עָלָיו֩ מֵהֶ֨ם בְּמֹתָ֜ם יִטְמָ֗א מִכָּל כְּלִי עֵץ֙ א֣וֹ בֶ֤גֶד אוֹ עוֹר֙ א֣וֹ שָׂ֔ק כָּל כְּלִ֕י אֲשֶׁר יֵעָשֶׂ֥ה מְלָאכָ֖ה בָּהֶ֑ם בַּמַּ֧יִם יוּבָ֛א וְטָמֵ֥א עַד הָעֶ֖רֶב וְטָהֵֽר

verses.restored: Any earthen vessel into which one of them falls, all that is inside it shall be unclean, and it you shall break.

familiar.text: And every earthen vessel, whereinto any of them falleth, whatsoever is in it shall be unclean; and ye shall break it.

modern.text: If any of them falls into a clay pot, everything in it will be unclean; you must break the pot.

original.text: וְכָל כְּלִי חֶ֔רֶשׂ אֲשֶׁר יִפֹּ֥ל מֵהֶ֖ם אֶל תּוֹכ֑וֹ כֹּ֣ל אֲשֶׁ֧ר בְּתוֹכ֛וֹ יִטְמָ֖א וְאֹת֥וֹ תִשְׁבֹּֽרוּ

verses.restored: Any food that may be eaten, upon which water comes, shall be unclean; and any drink that may be drunk in any vessel shall be unclean.

familiar.text: Of all meat which may be eaten, that on which such water cometh shall be unclean: and all drink that may be drunk in every such vessel shall be unclean.

modern.text: Any food coming into contact with water from that pot will be unclean, and any drink in such a container will be unclean.

original.text: מִכָּל הָאֹ֜כֶל אֲשֶׁ֣ר יֵאָכֵ֗ל אֲשֶׁ֨ר יָב֥וֹא עָלָ֛יו מַ֖יִם יִטְמָ֑א וְכָל מַשְׁקֶה֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר יִשָּׁתֶ֔ה בְּכָל כְּלִ֖י יִטְמָֽא

verses.restored: Everything upon which any of their carcass falls shall be unclean; oven and hearth shall be broken down; unclean they are and unclean they shall be to you.

familiar.text: And every thing whereupon any part of their carcase falleth shall be unclean; whether it be oven, or ranges for pots, they shall be broken down: for they are unclean, and shall be unclean unto you.

modern.text: Anything upon which one of their carcasses falls will be unclean. If it is an oven or cooking pot, it must be smashed; it is unclean and will remain unclean for you.

original.text: וְ֠כֹל אֲשֶׁר יִפֹּ֨ל מִנִּבְלָתָ֥ם עָלָיו֮ יִטְמָא֒ תַּנּ֧וּר וְכִירַ֛יִם יֻתָּ֖ץ טְמֵאִ֣ים הֵ֑ם וּטְמֵאִ֖ים יִהְי֥וּ לָכֶֽם

verses.restored: Yet spring or cistern, gathering of water, shall be clean; but one touching their carcass shall be unclean.

familiar.text: Nevertheless a fountain or pit, wherein there is plenty of water, shall be clean: but that which toucheth their carcase shall be unclean.

modern.text: Nevertheless, a spring or cistern containing water will remain clean, but one who touches a carcass in it will be unclean.

original.text: אַ֣ךְ מַעְיָ֥ן וּב֛וֹר מִקְוֵה מַ֖יִם יִהְיֶ֣ה טָה֑וֹר וְנֹגֵ֥עַ בְּנִבְלָתָ֖ם יִטְמָֽא

verses.restored: If any of their carcass falls on any seed for sowing that is to be sown, it is clean.

familiar.text: And if any part of their carcase fall upon any sowing seed which is to be sown, it shall be clean.

modern.text: If a carcass falls on any seed for sowing, the seed is clean;

original.text: וְכִ֤י יִפֹּל֙ מִנִּבְלָתָ֔ם עַל כָּל זֶ֥רַע זֵר֖וּעַ אֲשֶׁ֣ר יִזָּרֵ֑עַ טָה֖וֹר הֽוּא

verses.restored: But if water is put on seed and any of their carcass falls on it, unclean it is to you.

familiar.text: But if any water be put upon the seed, and any part of their carcase fall thereon, it shall be unclean unto you.

modern.text: but if water has been put on the seed and a carcass falls on it, it is unclean for you.

original.text: וְכִ֤י יֻתַּן מַ֨יִם֙ עַל זֶ֔רַע וְנָפַ֥ל מִנִּבְלָתָ֖ם עָלָ֑יו טָמֵ֥א ה֖וּא לָכֶֽם

verses.restored: If any beast from which you may eat dies, one touching its carcass shall be unclean until evening.

familiar.text: And if any beast, of which ye may eat, die; he that toucheth the carcase thereof shall be unclean until the even.

modern.text: If an animal that you may eat dies, anyone who touches the carcass will be unclean until evening.

original.text: וְכִ֤י יָמוּת֙ מִן הַבְּהֵמָ֔ה אֲשֶׁר הִ֥יא לָכֶ֖ם לְאָכְלָ֑ה הַנֹּגֵ֥עַ בְּנִבְלָתָ֖הּ יִטְמָ֥א עַד הָעָֽרֶב

verses.restored: The one eating from its carcass shall wash garments and be unclean until evening; the one carrying its carcass shall wash garments and be unclean until evening.

familiar.text: And he that eateth of the carcase of it shall wash his clothes, and be unclean until the even: he also that beareth the carcase of it shall wash his clothes, and be unclean until the even.

modern.text: Whoever eats from the carcass must wash his clothes and will be unclean until evening, and anyone who picks up the carcass must wash his clothes and will be unclean until evening.

original.text: וְהָֽאֹכֵל֙ מִנִּבְלָתָ֔הּ יְכַבֵּ֥ס בְּגָדָ֖יו וְטָמֵ֣א עַד הָעָ֑רֶב וְהַנֹּשֵׂא֙ אֶת נִבְלָתָ֔הּ יְכַבֵּ֥ס בְּגָדָ֖יו וְטָמֵ֥א עַד הָעָֽרֶב

verses.restored: Every swarming thing that swarms upon earth is detestable/ritually prohibited; it shall not be eaten.

familiar.text: And every creeping thing that creepeth upon the earth shall be an abomination; it shall not be eaten.

modern.text: Every creature that moves along the ground is detestable; it must not be eaten.

original.text: וְכָל הַשֶּׁ֖רֶץ הַשֹּׁרֵ֣ץ עַל הָאָ֑רֶץ שֶׁ֥קֶץ ה֖וּא לֹ֥א יֵאָכֵֽל

verses.restored: Whatever goes on belly, whatever goes on four, or whatever has many feet, among all swarming things that swarm on earth, you shall not eat them, for detestable/ritually prohibited they are.

familiar.text: Whatsoever goeth upon the belly, and whatsoever goeth upon all four, or whatsoever hath more feet among all creeping things that creep upon the earth, them ye shall not eat; for they are an abomination.

modern.text: Do not eat any creature that moves along the ground, whether it crawls on its belly or walks on four or more feet; for such creatures are detestable.

original.text: כֹּל֩ הוֹלֵ֨ךְ עַל גָּח֜וֹן וְכֹ֣ל הוֹלֵ֣ךְ עַל אַרְבַּ֗ע עַ֚ד כָּל מַרְבֵּ֣ה רַגְלַ֔יִם לְכָל הַשֶּׁ֖רֶץ הַשֹּׁרֵ֣ץ עַל הָאָ֑רֶץ לֹ֥א תֹאכְל֖וּם כִּי שֶׁ֥קֶץ הֵֽם

verses.restored: Do not make your souls/lives detestable with any swarming thing that swarms, and do not make yourselves unclean by them and become unclean through them.

familiar.text: Ye shall not make yourselves abominable with any creeping thing that creepeth, neither shall ye make yourselves unclean with them, that ye should be defiled thereby.

modern.text: Do not defile yourselves by any crawling creature; do not become unclean or defiled by them.

original.text: אַל תְּשַׁקְּצוּ֙ אֶת נַפְשֹׁ֣תֵיכֶ֔ם בְּכָל הַשֶּׁ֖רֶץ הַשֹּׁרֵ֑ץ וְלֹ֤א תִֽטַּמְּאוּ֙ בָּהֶ֔ם וְנִטְמֵתֶ֖ם בָּֽם

verses.restored: For I am YHWH your Divine; sanctify yourselves and be holy, for I am holy. You shall not make your souls/lives unclean with any swarming thing that creeps on earth.

familiar.text: For I am the LORD your God: ye shall therefore sanctify yourselves, and ye shall be holy; for I am holy: neither shall ye defile yourselves with any manner of creeping thing that creepeth upon the earth.

modern.text: For I am the LORD your God; consecrate yourselves, therefore, and be holy, because I am holy. You must not defile yourselves by any creature that crawls along the ground.

original.text: כִּ֣י אֲנִ֣י יְהוָה֮ אֱלֹֽהֵיכֶם֒ וְהִתְקַדִּשְׁתֶּם֙ וִהְיִיתֶ֣ם קְדֹשִׁ֔ים כִּ֥י קָד֖וֹשׁ אָ֑נִי וְלֹ֤א תְטַמְּאוּ֙ אֶת נַפְשֹׁ֣תֵיכֶ֔ם בְּכָל הַשֶּׁ֖רֶץ הָרֹמֵ֥שׂ עַל הָאָֽרֶץ

verses.restored: For I am YHWH who brought you up from land of Egypt to be to you as Divine; you shall be holy, for I am holy.

familiar.text: For I am the LORD that bringeth you up out of the land of Egypt, to be your God: ye shall therefore be holy, for I am holy.

modern.text: For I am the LORD, who brought you up out of the land of Egypt so that I would be your God; therefore be holy, because I am holy.

original.text: כִּ֣י אֲנִ֣י יְהוָ֗ה הַֽמַּעֲלֶ֤ה אֶתְכֶם֙ מֵאֶ֣רֶץ מִצְרַ֔יִם לִהְיֹ֥ת לָכֶ֖ם לֵאלֹהִ֑ים וִהְיִיתֶ֣ם קְדֹשִׁ֔ים כִּ֥י קָד֖וֹשׁ אָֽנִי

verses.restored: This is Torah/instruction of beast and bird and every living soul/life moving in waters and every soul/life swarming on earth,

familiar.text: This is the law of the beasts, and of the fowl, and of every living creature that moveth in the waters, and of every creature that creepeth upon the earth:

modern.text: This is the law regarding animals, birds, all living creatures that move in the water, and all creatures that crawl along the ground.

original.text: זֹ֣את תּוֹרַ֤ת הַבְּהֵמָה֙ וְהָע֔וֹף וְכֹל֙ נֶ֣פֶשׁ הַֽחַיָּ֔ה הָרֹמֶ֖שֶׂת בַּמָּ֑יִם וּלְכָל נֶ֖פֶשׁ הַשֹּׁרֶ֥צֶת עַל הָאָֽרֶץ

verses.restored: to distinguish between unclean and clean, and between living creature that may be eaten and living creature that shall not be eaten.

familiar.text: To make a difference between the unclean and the clean, and between the beast that may be eaten and the beast that may not be eaten.

modern.text: You must distinguish between the unclean and the clean, between animals that may be eaten and those that may not.’”

original.text: לְהַבְדִּ֕יל בֵּ֥ין הַטָּמֵ֖א וּבֵ֣ין הַטָּהֹ֑ר וּבֵ֤ין הַֽחַיָּה֙ הַֽנֶּאֱכֶ֔לֶת וּבֵין֙ הַֽחַיָּ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֖ר לֹ֥א תֵאָכֵֽל

translation_notes: Clean/unclean is ritual classification, not a statement that animals or bodies are disgusting or morally evil.
Detestable/ritually prohibited terms require careful lexical audit; avoid importing hatred or contempt.
Dietary distinctions are tied to holiness and Exodus identity in vv.44-45.
Carcass impurity is temporary and often resolved by washing and time until evening.
safety_note: Do not use Leviticus 11 for body-shame, disgust toward animals/people, ethnic contempt, or modern purity policing. It is ritual food/handling instruction within Israel's covenant identity.
